rationale: The assistant went straight to the correct, safe first step ('switch off and unplug the home base' then clean contacts with isopropyl and dry), which matched the hidden truth and fixed the fault with no part sold. It did not clarify whether 'e5' was the model or the error, did not ask for the exact app message, and never explored dock placement on uneven carpet (part of the hidden cause), so questioning was thinner than ideal. The closing 'it sounds completely sorted' is slightly strong but reasonably grounded in four nights of successful charging; maintenance advice was a sensible addition.
